===== sqlserver/marts.fct_orders/load.default.sql =====
-- dbdatabuild rendered load operation. Generated by `render --write`; do not edit.
-- model:           marts.fct_orders
-- operation:       default
-- target:          sqlserver
-- strategy:        delete_insert_by_key
-- definition hash: 73c24ac7a06fff501b4b69301f6410951857df75cda1267627f9e84ab56af541
-- parameters:      none
SET XACT_ABORT ON;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #ddb_stage;
BEGIN TRANSACTION;
WITH recent AS (SELECT * FROM staging.orders WHERE order_date >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE)), ddb_body AS (SELECT r.order_id, r.customer_id, r.amount FROM recent AS r ORDER BY CASE WHEN r.order_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, r.order_id OFFSET 0 ROWS)
SELECT [order_id], [customer_id], [amount] INTO #ddb_stage FROM ddb_body;
DELETE FROM [marts].[fct_orders] WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #ddb_stage AS src WHERE src.[order_id] = [marts].[fct_orders].[order_id]);
INSERT INTO [marts].[fct_orders] ([order_id], [customer_id], [amount])
SELECT [order_id], [customer_id], [amount] FROM #ddb_stage;
DROP TABLE #ddb_stage;
COMMIT TRANSACTION;
